en.html:
Kageaki"Captain. You must not do such things. It puts me in difficulty."
Kanae"...In difficulty?"
Kageaki"Yes."
Kanae"............"
Kageaki"Your life is not to be treated as something without value. In future, please exercise restraint."
Kanae"...Without value."
Kageaki"Yes."
Kanae"...What I did... had no value?"
Kageaki"None."
Kanae"............"
Kageaki"Please exercise restraint."
Kanae"...If it were reversed..."
Kageaki"Yes?"
Kanae"If our positions were reversed, what would you have done, Mr. Kageaki? Abandoned me?"
Kageaki"No."
Kanae"..."
Kageaki"I believe I would have acted to save you, as far as my ability allowed."
Kanae"————"
Kageaki"...?"

en.html:
Kanae"...That is not consistent with reason, is it?"
Kageaki"With respect, I consider it entirely reasonable."
Kanae"..."
Kanae"Why?"
Kageaki"As you know, Captain, I am one who ought to be judged by your hand. For me to save you, the reasoning holds."
Kageaki"Reverse the positions, and it does not."
Kanae"That is..."
Kanae"..."
Kanae"But..."
Kageaki"Yes?"
Kanae"I am neither a saint nor God’s messenger, Mr. Kageaki."
Kageaki"I know."
Kanae"In the army, I have taken many lives."
Kageaki"No doubt."
Kanae"Outside the army also. Perhaps I have killed more people than you."
Kageaki"Possibly."
Kanae"...Can such a woman be any better than you?"
Kageaki"Better or worse, leave that aside. You too, Captain, appear to be deep in sin."
Kanae"Yes."
Kageaki"In time you will receive its reckoning. —As you have already prepared yourself to do."
Kanae"..."
Kageaki"But not by shielding one such as me. Never in that fashion."
Kanae"Why?"
Kageaki"Captain... Suppose those you sent to the underworld with your own hands were to appear here now."
Kageaki"Could you look straight back into their faces?"
Kanae"Yes."
